lines: The prior triad, essence of the light-part,
is sun; the final, prevalent in rest-bliss, is moon —
up to where the action-portion no longer enters.
l4.sanskrit_cite: atra ca prācyaṃ parāmarśatrayaṃ prakāśabhāgasāratvāt sūryātmakaṃ caramaṃ parāmarśatrayaṃ viśrāntisvabhāvāhlādaprādhānyāt somātmakam iyati yāvat karmāṃśasya anupraveśo nāsti

reads_against.argmap: How are the two triads characterized cosmically? → Sun/moon marks the triads' function-boundary: light-side before action-entry, bliss-rest after.
c1_essence: Prior triad sun-natured by light-essence, final triad moon-natured by rest-bliss — the boundary where action-portion stops entering.
